title: ikm_buf double-free in ioctl_do_kdf when ikm_fd set and post-lock check fails
description: Trigger: open fd, call INIT (makes it OPERATION), then call DO_KDF with valid ikm_fd pointing to a KEY fd and zeroed _pad. Inside ioctl_do_kdf: ikm_buf is kmalloc'd and filled (lines 1785-1827), _pad check passes, mutex_lock acquired, then line 1837 sees fd_type \!= FDTYPE_UNSET → goto out_inbuf_clear → falls through to out_free_okm which kfree(ikm_buf) WITHOUT setting ikm_buf=NULL → mutex_unlock → goto out_zero → out_zero sees non-NULL ikm_buf → second kfree() on already-freed memory. Bad outcome: kernel heap double-free + use-after-free (memzero_explicit writes 64 bytes into freed slab). All goto-out_inbuf_clear paths trigger this when ikm_fd \!= -1: fd not UNSET (line 1837), inbuf_len > 0 (1845), lookup failure (1864), no kdf callback (1873), fips_gate fail (1883), iterations below min (1893), salt_len below min (1903), okm_buf kmalloc fail (1910). Fix: add ikm_buf = NULL after kfree in out_free_okm.
